yaml:
# charter.yaml for the `orders` service (CONTRACT.md §3).
apiVersion: attache.io/v1alpha1
kind: Charter
service:
  name: orders
  namespace: attache-demo
  app_port: 8080
agents:
  - name: ops-assistant
    type: orchestrator
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    system: |
      You are the operations assistant embedded in the orders service.
      Answer questions about orders and stock. Use lookup_order for order
      details, stock_analyst for anything about inventory levels or reorders,
      and inventory_admin_reset only when explicitly asked to reset admin
      counters. Be concise and state which tools you used.
    tools:
      - name: lookup_order
        description: Look up an order by id in the orders service.
        type: service
        service: orders
        method: GET
        path: /orders/{order_id}
        parameters:
          type: object
          properties:
            order_id: { type: string, description: "Order id such as 1001" }
          required: [order_id]
      - name: stock_analyst
        description: Ask the inventory service's stock analyst agent about stock levels, SKUs and reorder advice.
        type: agent
        agent: stock-analyst
        service: inventory
      - name: order_triage
        description: Ask the local order triage agent to classify an order problem by urgency.
        type: agent
        agent: order-triage
      - name: inventory_admin_reset
        description: Reset the inventory admin counters (administrative, destructive).
        type: service
        service: inventory
        method: POST
        path: /admin/reset
    budgets:
      max_tokens_per_call: 2048      # room for adaptive thinking on real Claude
      max_calls_per_minute: 30
      max_cost_usd_per_day: 5.0
      max_steps: 6
  - name: order-triage
    type: agent
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    system: |
      You classify order problems into urgency P1 (blocked revenue), P2
      (customer waiting) or P3 (cosmetic). Answer with the level and one line.
    budgets:
      max_tokens_per_call: 1024
      max_calls_per_minute: 60
      max_cost_usd_per_day: 1.0
      max_steps: 2
guardrails:
  max_input_bytes: 8192
  pii_redact: true
  input_deny:
    - name: no-secrets
      regex: "(?i)(api[_-]?key|password|secret)\\s*[:=]"
  allowed_tools:
    ops-assistant: [lookup_order, stock_analyst, order_triage, inventory_admin_reset]
  allowed_services:
    ops-assistant: [orders, inventory]
authz:
  default: deny
  callers:
    - identity: local
      agents: ["*"]
  services:
    - name: self-orders
      agent: ops-assistant
      service: orders
      allow: ["GET /orders/*"]
    - name: egress-inventory
      agent: ops-assistant
      service: inventory
      allow: ["GET /stock", "GET /stock/*", "POST /admin/*"]   # egress allows /admin on purpose: the inventory charter is the one that denies it
audit:
  sink: stdout
  redact: []
